summary: A complete deep dive into Studio Bagno's Premium Stone Composite - What exactly is MarmoTech and what are the benefits on this innovative and tactile premium surface?
title: Marmotech Baths - The Surface That Redefines Luxury
bodyHtml:
What is MarmoTech?

MarmoTech is Studio Bagno’s premium stone composite, designed for those who seek luxury and durability in their bathrooms both big and small.

Finely crafted from 55% natural minerals including ground Marble, 40% pure acrylic resin, and 5% colour pigment, MarmoTech offers the perfect balance of practicality and sophistication.

Explore MarmoTech Baths

Silky Smooth & Hygienic

Designed to feel as good as it looks, MarmoTech’s velvety, non-porous surface is not only luxurious to the skin, it’s also resistant to moisture and bacteria, ensuring a more hygienic and low-maintenance bathing experience.

Superior Heat Retention

MarmoTech heats up quickly and helps retain warmth, so you can enjoy a longer, more comfortable soak without needing to constantly top up with hot water.

Effortless Maintenance & Long-Lasting Durability

Cleaning is simple—warm water and biodegradable detergent are all you need to keep your MarmoTech bath pristine. Plus, with high impact resistance tested against rigorous conditions, you can trust it to stand the test of time.

A Complete Matte White Bathroom Solution

MarmoTech’s Matte White finish is designed to work effortlessly across our entire Matte White collection, offering a cohesive, beautifully curated and elevated Matte White aesthetic for any bathroom style.
